desc: Features a DPMS 10.5" Lightweight M-Lok rail, low-profile gas block, and A2 flash hider. Forged 7075-T6 A3 AR upper is MIL-SPEC machined and hard coat anodized, including forward assist and dust cover. Full-auto profile bolt carrier group utilizes a shot-peened, mil-spec Carpenter No. 158 steel bolt and a mil-spec staked gas key. Forged 7075-T6 aluminum lower, marked "MULTI," hard coat anodized, and fitted with a Magpul MOE Grip, SB Tactical SBA3 Pistol Stabilizing Brace, 6-position 7075 buffer tube, and DPMS Panther Polished Trigger.
